item.title: Trump already tried to hurt Iran with sanctions once - and it didn't work
item.description: President Trump is again hoping to use economic pressure to force Iran to the negotiating table.

item.title: Work set to begin in Trump's plan for triumphal arch
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with New York Times reporter Emily Badger about the Trump administration's plans to move forward with construction of a triumphal arch.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with New York Times reporter Emily Badger about the Trump administration's plans to move forward with construction of a triumphal arch.

item.title: IRS targets private schools that help racial minority students
item.description: The Trump administration has said it will end the tax-exempt status for universities with programs that help racial minority students.

item.title: The price of diesel hits a record high
item.description: The price of diesel has reached an all-time high, a result of the war in Iran and Ukraine's attacks on Russian refineries. That will matter across the supply chain.

item.title: Trump administration pushes to remove tax exemption for private colleges with DEI policies
item.description: The Trump administration is proposing a rule that would strip private schools and colleges of their tax-exempt status if they provide targeted help to students based on their race.

item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei is escalating a dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands with tougher sanctions targeting companies involved in a major offshore oil project

item.title: 2 trapped workers rescued from a hydropower tunnel 9 days after Nepal floods
item.description: Officials say rescuers in Nepal have pulled two workers alive from a tunnel Friday during an ongoing operation. The rescues come nine days after the Aug. 26 floods.

item.title: The Trump administration still aims to make state citizenship lists ahead of midterms
item.description: The Trump administration is taking the unprecedented step of creating lists of adult citizens who are eligible to vote in each state – but will not meet its own deadline 60 days before Election Day.

item.title: Leon Black defies subpoena to testify in Epstein inquiry and sues House panel
item.description: The billionaire investor is under two subpoenas from the House Oversight Committee. But in his lawsuit, Black says the panel doesn't have the authority to compel him to share nondisclosure agreements.
